tier_A: Existing 60 strict tasks preserved byte-for-byte; separate regression/strong-evidence pool
tier_B_standard: Trusted official expected outputs; supported stdin scoring; at least 2 online inputs and 6 input-disjoint sealed inputs; reference implementation not mandatory
tier_B_thin: Supported official scoring; at least 1 online and 1 sealed input but below standard coverage; auxiliary only
tier_C: Unavailable/malformed expected outputs, unsupported call-based/interactive/special checker, ambiguous output contract or insufficient disjoint tests; not promotion evidence
online_roles: All trustworthy statement samples plus at most 2 additional official test inputs, ensure at least 2 online where possible. Remaining official cases form locked final pool; select first 6 by seeded hash for initial Worker acceptance and preserve remaining test references.
sealed_role: No normalized input overlap; contradictory expectations quarantine. First 24 by frozen seeded hash retained as final evaluation subset (minimum6 for B standard); first6 initially Worker-checked. Remaining official tests remain raw-source-only, never online, with reproducible partition and aggregate hash. No sealed answers sent to model.
sampling: Seeded SHA256 within source/difficulty, never source row prefixes or model outcomes; no replacement based on model results
original_split_roles: APPS train primarily learning. APPS test is explicitly research-reassigned before model outcomes: SHA(identity)%3==0 confirmation, otherwise eligible development stream; official labels always retained. CC train learning and valid/test confirmation. LCB official release_v6 test similarly partitioned by identity hash.
cross_source_separation: Canonical identity, normalized statements and near-duplicate connected components; one original/lineage component across both selected pools; exposed components excluded
scoring: Pinned official LCB stdout semantics adapted to existing isolated Worker; CodeContests output matching with explicit exact-integer safety correction; APPS official IO with exact ordered tokens, never legacy set fallback
source_reference_policy: Reference absence is evidence label, not automatic rejection. Positive expected-output replay fixtures validate adapter/transport only, never claim independent solution correctness; available human reference validation separately recorded.
worker: Reuse existing Linux Worker, one admission thread; record concurrent S20-A operation. No change to its image, allocation, protocol, tasks or budget.
metadata_revision_reason: APPS train exposes few supported stdin tasks with >=8 tests; preserve disjoint official-test research development and confirmation roles instead of relabeling official split or reducing scoring quality.
pre_worker_review: Exclude any-order/arbitrary/case-insensitive/absolute-error contracts lacking supported checker. Review selected output sections before paid use.
